coursePage.title: Course Page Settings
coursePage.description: Control visibility of course page elements.
coursePage.allowViewSlidesInReadOnly: Allow viewing slides on published / in-review courses (read-only)
coursePage.showLearnerProgressReport: Show "Student Progress" tab in Reports (per-learner course progress)
coursePage.showAdvancedCourseIds: Show advanced IDs menu on Course Details (course / package session / session / level)

coursePermission.title: Course Permission
coursePermission.description: Control what this role can do on a course and its slides.
coursePermission.requireCourseApproval: Require admin approval before publishing new courses (Submit for Review)

authoredCoursesCard.title: Authored Courses Card
authoredCoursesCard.description: Control which actions appear on the course card under Explore Courses → Authored Courses.

courseListCard.title: Course List Card
courseListCard.description: Control which details appear on each course card under Explore Courses.

courseCreation.title: Course Creation
courseCreation.description: Control who can create courses, AI entry points, and chapter setup defaults.
courseCreation.requirePackageSelectionForNewChapter: Require package session selection when adding a new chapter

courseListTabs.title: Course List Tabs
courseListTabs.description: Configure visible tabs, their order, and the default tab. Course Approval is admin-only and stays hidden for this role.

courseDetailsTabs.title: Course Details Tabs
courseDetailsTabs.description: Choose which tabs are visible and set the default tab.
courseDetailsTabs.offlineLockedMessage: Turned off because offline downloads are disabled for the institute (Settings → Offline Access).

uiOptions.title: UI Options
uiOptions.showSettingsDescription: Hides the Settings gear in the sidebar rail. You can still open Settings directly at /settings.
uiOptions.showAssistDockDescription: Guides, Training, Assist, Issues, What's new, Explore & Admin App. Hidden for this role by default.

sidebarCategories.title: Sidebar Categories
sidebarCategories.description: Configure visibility, order, and default category for the sidebar.

sidebarTabs.title: Sidebar Tabs
sidebarTabs.description: Order and toggle visibility. Settings tab is always hidden for Teachers.

courseContentTypes.title: Course Content Types
courseContentTypes.description: Enable or disable slide content types. Video has an extra in-video question option.
courseContentTypes.question: Question
courseContentTypes.showAddVideoQuestion: Can add questions to video slides
courseContentTypes.showConvertToSplitScreen: Can convert video to split screen

learnerManagement.title: Learner Management
learnerManagement.description: Configure learner management permissions and access controls.
learnerManagement.showApprovalToggle: Show Approval Requests toggle on Learners list
learnerManagement.allowDeletePayments: Allow permanently deleting payments & invoices (cannot be undone)
learnerManagement.canApplyDiscounts: Allow applying discounts when enrolling learners, bulk assigning, or creating invoices

dashboardWidgets.title: Dashboard Widgets
dashboardWidgets.description: Order and toggle which widgets teachers can see.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Configure institute and profile visibility and edit access.

postLoginRedirect.title: Post-login Redirect
postLoginRedirect.description: Choose where to redirect teachers after login.
